Edward de Vere, the 17th Earl of Oxford
# Edward de Vere was a 16th-century English nobleman, poet, and playwright who grew up in the court of Queen Elizabeth I.
# He was known for his flamboyant fashion, love of perfumes, and literary work, with some scholars even identifying him as the real William Shakespeare.
# A famous anecdote describes him farting in front of Queen Elizabeth, which supposedly embarrassed him so much that he left the country for years.
